title: Jointly Modeling Preferences and Imperfect Decision-Making in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Do preferences Large Language Models (LLMs) express in standard elicitation tasks predict their strategic behaviour? LLM agents interacting with humans and other AI systems face potentially conflicting objectives, such as individual welfare, group welfare, and environmental concerns. Prior work characterizes LLM preferences through behavioral-economic and psychological elicitation or strategic games, but rarely tests consistency across settings and prediction in other strategic environments. This requires modeling how competing objectives jointly shape behavior, whereas existing approaches typically measure preference dimensions in isolation. Drawing on utility theory, we introduce the Preference-Behavior Model (PBM), which combines a preference representation with mechanisms capturing imperfect utility maximization. translated_title: 大语言模型中偏好与不完美决策的联合建模
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在标准偏好引出任务中表达的偏好能否预测其策略性行为？与人类和其他AI系统交互的LLM智能体面临可能相互冲突的目标，例如个人福利、群体福利和环境问题。先前的工作通过行为经济学与心理学的引出方法或策略博弈来刻画LLM的偏好，但很少测试不同设置之间的一致性，以及在其他策略环境中的预测能力。这需要对相互竞争的目标如何共同塑造行为进行建模，而现有方法通常孤立地测量各个偏好维度。借鉴效用理论，我们提出了偏好-行为模型，该模型将偏好表示与刻画不完美效用最大化的机制相结合。我们将模型估计表述为一个逆博弈问题，从观测到的行为中联合推断偏好与行为参数。
tldr: 该论文提出偏好-行为模型（PBM），将偏好表示与不完美效用最大化机制相结合，并通过逆博弈问题从观测行为中联合推断LLM的偏好与行为参数，以预测其在不同策略环境中的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Preference-Behavior Model (PBM), which combines a preference representation with mechanisms capturing imperfect utility maximization, and formulates estimation as an inverse-game problem to jointly infer LLM preferences and behavioral parameters from observed behavior.
